posts.name: Kerredai
posts.cooked:
Based on some testing -- and several unlocks -- on the Steam thread, we seem to have gotten the general rule "play a bunch of bots, have them deal a bunch of damage, Unity finishes with single-digit HP."

Also, having had Unity -- and possibly other Freedom 5 characters -- previously defeated by Iron Legacy is seemingly a requirement.

There's something we're missing, though, because I did all of that and didn't get the unlock; an interesting theory one poster proposed was that you needed to have another Freedom Five member (probably one who isn't Legacy on the team), play the bot corresponding to that character, and have that bot do its thing (e.g. Stealth Bot redirect, Turret/Cryo inflict damage, etc.) at least once. Didn't seem to work for me, though. I begin to suspect there's another prior game requirement -- like having Baron Blade incap Young Legacy, an idea a lot of people have thrown around.

posts.cooked:
Update.

 

A lot of people on the steam forums are getting her. Everyone is looking for concrete evidence on how to get her.

 

After reading all the comments and trying each strategy here's what happy to say I found out.

 

-HP must be below 10 for Unity.

-Must use each freedom bots function at least once.

-Must meet a certain amount of bots in play.

-A bot nor Unity does NOT have to deal the final blow.

-HP does NOT have to be below 10 for all heroes.

-Must lose previously to iron legacy with the freedom five. (-legacy)

-Villian does NOT matter.

-Environment does NOT matter.

(All the above is based on unlockers words with screen shots as proof)

 

After playing 24 matches with various combos of the above and trying I am happy to say the search for concrete evidence is over.

~~~~~~~~~~

~~~~~~~~~

~~~~~~~~

~~~~~~~

~~~~~~

~~~~~

~~~~

~~~

~~

~

Well at least for me cause I give up.

-I had intentionally lost to iron legacy a match before with the freedom team.

-I had every golem out at the end except for one bee bot.

-I had done over 70 damage with golems.

-I had each freedom bot use its function.

-All HP was below 10 for everything on the map.

-Raptor bot did the final damage.

(Setup was: Absolute Zero, Omnitron-X, Unity. Time Cataclysm. Baron Blade)

Good luck! The variant search is over for me after 24 games with Unity trying to figure this out and 13 with Bunker trying to figure his out. I'm done tearing myself apart. It's up to you now.

posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked:
This is a bit of a double post from the Bunker discussion:

Just got both Golem Unity and Engine of War Bunker in the same game.  Team was:

Argent Adept, (normal) Bunker, Omnitron-X, Unity vs. Baron Blade in the Block

Based on some stuff from the Steam forums, I thought that Bunker dying in the Block (where Fright Train is seen) was a good idea.  I thought that Prison Riot might be a necessary component, but I never saw it, so I guess it isn't.

 

I basically used AA and O-X to give Unity tons of card plays while Bunker used Grenade Launcher on various targets and stacked up the Omni-Cannon.  Once Unity had a fleet of bots, I had Bunker Omni-Cannon himself and then I let Unity's bots start hitting herself to get her down to 6.  Raptor bot won the game with a hit for 12 against the Baron.

I started using O-X on The Block to try for Prison Riot, but never saw it (or apparently needed it).

Prior to this game (based on advice from both forums) I lost 2 games against Iron Legacy using various Freedom Six team comps.

 

Specific to Unity, I had Champion Bot, Turret Bot, Stealth Bot, Swift Bot, AND Cryo Bot out, and all of them had done "their thing" at least once.  I also had all 3 Platform Bots out, as well as one Raptor Bot, and maybe 1 Bee.

I just unlocked her! She got incapped by Iron Legacy, then we did Bunker, OmniX, AA, and Unity at The Block; she had 5HP and at one point all the bots made an appearance. I tried it before with this setup and it didn't work, this time I used Powered Shockwave to finish it. I didn't play that card the time it didn't work, so I wonder if you have to play Powered Shockwave at least once. 

Then again, I had OmniX and Argent Adept giving Unity so many card plays and draws, it was sick. I think she played everything. She used 3 construction pylons, she activated Volatile Parts, she brainstormed twice, she did NOT play modular workbench, she did NOT play scrap metal, she did play Flash forge and Supply Crate, she did NOT play Robot Relcation or Hasty Augmentation. 

My theory: Have Unity get incapped by Iron Legacy, then use Powered Shock wave. Unity must either have played 5/8/10 bots or have done 20/30/50 damage between her and her bots. 

Hope this helps!

posts.name: chrismith85
posts.cooked:
Got her! My setup was Ra, Scholar, Argent Adept, Omniton-X, and Unity versus Ambuscade in the Block. I had a bunch of bots out, including all five F5 bots (though I don't think they all used their powers; Cryo Bot was never hit), ended with Unity at 7 HP, and a Raptor Bot dealt the finishing blow. Differences from my previous failed runs:

  • In two previous attempts I used the same team, but with Young Legacy in place of Ra. Maybe Young Legacy (or just Legacy in general) aren't allowed on the team? Would make some sense, since Golem Unity is from after Legacy left the team. Has anyone unlocked her when playing with Legacy?
  • I fought Ambuscade instead of Baron Blade. I doubt this made any difference, since other people have unlocked her with Blade, but it doesn't look like the Baron is required for the unlock.
  • I played "Powered Shockwave" near the end of the game, when 9 or 10 bots were out. Doesn't sound like this is a strict requirement, but maybe it help me hit a damage threshold that's required for the unlock. I also wonder if Unity herself has to deal a certain amount of damage, rather than her bots? I feel like I did less damage with her overall than in previous failed attempts, but since I played Shockwave this time Unity definitely dealt more damage personally than before.
